# tomswallapi_conntrack (Resource)

A connection-tracking control rule (e.g. notrack, or assign a conntrack helper).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_conntrack" "ftp_helper" {
  action = "helper"
  helper = "ftp"
  proto  = "tcp"
  dport  = ["21"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) notrack, helper, ...

### Optional

- `chain` (String) Chain: P (PREROUTING), O (OUTPUT), or PO (both).
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `dport` (List of String) Destination ports or port ranges to match.
- `helper` (String) Conntrack helper (ftp, sip, tftp, ...).
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation priority; lower first.
- `proto` (String) Protocol to match (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `source` (String) Source to match (zone, interface, or address in shorewall notation).
- `sport` (List of String) Source ports or port ranges to match.
- `user` (String) Owner of locally generated packets to match (user[:group]).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_conntrack.ftp_helper 42
```
